Our values

Customer Success
We are committed to proactively understand, prioritize, and meet the diverse needs of our customers, ensuring their satisfaction, loyalty, and achievement of desired outcomes throughout their journey with our product.
Sense of Urgency
We emphasize rapid and efficient responses to customer needs, market trends, and internal processes, fostering a culture that values quick action and timely delivery of solutions. .
Innovation
We are committed to continuous improvement, creative problem-solving, and the development of groundbreaking solutions to drive competitive advantage and meet evolving customer needs.
Employee Empowerment
We foster a culture where individuals are encouraged, trusted, and equipped with the autonomy, resources, and support to make impactful decisions, driving creativity, ownership, and overall company success.
Collaboration and Respect
We believe in an environment where diverse perspectives are valued, teamwork is encouraged, and mutual respect promotes an atmosphere of innovation  and collective achievement.
Doing the Right Thing
We consistently uphold moral principles, integrity, and responsibility in decision- making, actions, and relationships, prioritizing ethical conduct above all else.

Dottie to the Top: Our Success Stories

“I’m most proud of evolving the product, introducing new features, and enabling clients to implement Dot Compliance more efficiently.”

Rubi Cohen joined Dot Compliance in 2019 as an architect and has spent five and a half years driving product advancements and streamlining client implementations. He attributes his background in Salesforce and the tech industry as a key factor to his success. Along the way, he has developed a deep understanding of the regulatory world and continues to stay updated on the latest technological advancements. In his personal time, Rubi plays tennis and soccer, and was once a league player for Maccabi Rehovot. If he could travel anywhere in the world, he would complete his travels through Central and South America, and if he could have any super power, it would be speed—because he always wants to be first.
Rubi Cohen
Technical Architect and Technical Leader

“Building a product that serves all our customers and establishing the product department from scratch has been my most rewarding achievement.”

Since joining Dot Compliance in 2014 as a solution engineer, Elinor Boussidan has grown into the role of director of product, leading a 15-person team and building a product department from the ground up. Her biggest accomplishments include launching a stable, high-quality product that meets diverse customer needs, implementing Agile methodologies, and balancing company goals with client expectations. Outside of work, Elinor enjoys listening to podcasts and attending performances and shows with her family. She dreams of hiking the Alps to take on an extreme challenge and wishes for the superpower to stop time, savoring life’s special moments a little longer.
Elinor Boussidan
Director of Product

“Relying on your team is important because we don’t know everything. It’s okay to ask for help, and having a strong support system makes a real difference.”

Cambrie Matranga joined Dot Compliance nearly two years ago as a sales development representative (SDR). She was quickly promoted to senior SDR while also stepping into a partner development role. That experience led to her current position as an inside sales representative, where she plays a key role in driving new business. Her biggest accomplishments include closing her first deal just one month into her new role and bringing in 18 opportunities in a single month. With a background in finance, Cambrie transitioned from financial services to SaaS, driven by her passion for working with people. Coming from a family with a strong sales background, she embraced the challenge and found her stride in tech sales. At Dot Compliance, she’s learned the power of collaboration and the value of reaching out for support when needed. Outside of work, Cambrie enjoys spending time with her dog, Ollie, taking long walks, and staying active with workouts like Pilates.
Cambrie Matranga
Inside Sales Representative

“The level of support and collaboration at Dot is unlike anywhere I’ve been—working with different people, gaining diverse perspectives, and leveraging collective insights has made a significant impact.”

Joe Bimonte joined Dot Compliance over two years ago, starting as a senior sales development representative (SDR), where he helped launch the referral partnership role while managing SDR responsibilities. That experience led to his promotion to account executive and now strategic account executive, where he focuses on long-term success for key customers. His biggest accomplishment has been building strong relationships—with colleagues, customers, and partners—driving both personal growth and business impact. Of this experience, he says, “I’m grateful every day for the opportunity to work alongside such talented individuals and collaborate with customers to drive real impact.” With a background in sales and business development, Joe has worked across partnerships, inbound, and outbound sales, gaining a full view of the sales cycle. At Dot Compliance, he’s learned that adaptability is key in a fast-moving environment. Outside of work, he enjoys traveling, sports, and exploring new restaurants with friends and family.
Joe Bimonte
Director of Commercial Sales

“I’ve learned I really enjoy growing with a company and seeing major change. As we scale, handling that growth and being part of the process has been both exciting and challenging—but it’s helped me grow in so many ways.”

Matt Heckman joined Dot Compliance in January 2024 as a senior consultant in professional services. He quickly moved into a technical services team lead role and is now practice manager for technical services, also contributing to the new product introductions (NPI) team. One of his biggest accomplishments has been leading the project for one of Dot Compliance’s largest customers in North America and building a fully custom solution for their 5,000 users, which has led to ongoing custom projects. With a background in cloud solutions and a chemical engineering degree, Matt thrives in fast-paced environments where adaptability and problem-solving are key. Outside of work, he enjoys snowboarding and spending time in Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine. A recent trip to Banff, Canada, combined his love for adventure and wildlife, making it a highlight of the season.
Matt Heckman
Director, Technical Services North America
